description: This file defines utility functions for processing voice wake commands in a Swift application, including text normalization, trigger detection, and command validation.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Normalizes a token by trimming whitespace and punctuation, and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: startsWithTrigger
methods.description: Checks if a transcript starts with any of the specified trigger phrases.

methods.name: textOnlyCommand
methods.description: Validates the transcript as a text-only voice command based on triggers, minimum length, and wake word.
